markets.note: The day's change: yields close to close in basis points (FRED DGS2 / DGS10); SPY log return into the day in basis points. A release at 8:30 a.m. comes before the open, so the day's move is the first full reaction; one at 2:00 p.m. shares the day with the morning.

note: Release days and first prints from ALFRED real-time data: "printed" is the value published that day, "prior" the period before as known that day (the release usually revises it), "today" the value now. The headline is the change the release reported on the prior period as revised that day. Periods first published before ALFRED kept a series' history have no first print. Clock times are the agencies' usual ones; unscheduled FOMC actions have none.
